trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload NullPointerException crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Fix top Android crasher ~4% of Android sessions. Repro steps: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, return to app. Root cause is NullPointerException in media picker callback when app is backgrounded mid-upload. Fix and land by Wednesday Aug 13 to allow QA time before mobile release on Aug 20. Acceptance criteria: crash no longer reproduces on Android 14, crash reports for this stack trace drop to zero in test, and fix is merged to release branch.

trello.name: Verify Android 14 crash fix on test devices
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Once Marcus lands the photo upload crash fix, confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices. Add verification to regression run for the sprint. Acceptance criteria: manual regression pass on Android 14 devices with background-mid-upload scenario succeeds with no crash, and test result is documented.

trello.name: Implement backend notes sync API for offline mode
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Build sync endpoint for notes list offline support promised to enterprise customers. Client sends last-synced timestamp, server returns delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for this sprint, no merge UI. Must be in code review before Elena is out Aug 17-18. Acceptance criteria: endpoint returns correct delta, handles timestamp input, respects last-write-wins, and passes unit/integration tests.

trello.name: Implement client offline notes cache and sync
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Client side for offline notes: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay writes when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria as agreed: app can be opened in airplane mode, notes list is visible, notes can be edited offline, and all changes reconcile with server on reconnect with no data loss. Document these acceptance criteria in the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Finish migration started with proof of concept build job. Complete test and release pipelines, keep nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins. Keep Jenkins alive until parallel week is clean. Acceptance criteria: build, test, release and nightly jobs run successfully in GitHub Actions, parallel runs match Jenkins results for one week with no failures, and Jenkins can be safely turned off after sign-off.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Mitigate incident where search endpoint was hammered by misbehaving script. Implement per-user rate limiting: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded. Add metrics counter to track users hitting the limit. Acceptance criteria: load test confirms 429 response after 100 req/min per user with Retry-After header present, and metrics are visible in monitoring.

trello.name: Update GDPR consent screen with opt-in toggles
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Legal flagged consent screen non-compliant for EU launch. Update privacy policy/consent screen to use opt-in consent with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, no single pre-checked box. Get final copy from legal. Must be included in Aug 20 mobile release; launch blocker. Acceptance criteria: screen shows separate unchecked toggles for analytics and marketing, consent is only recorded after explicit opt-in, and screen passes legal review.

trello.name: Add automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Payments flow has no automated coverage and burned last release. Write regression tests for purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation path. Tests must run in CI as part of new GitHub Actions pipeline. Acceptance criteria: tests pass in CI, cover all four flows, and are included in the release pipeline gate for Aug 20.
